llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam indicators: unclear company information (no verifiable address, business email, or phone number); only a generic contact form; SSL certificate issues; emphasis on '100% safe shopping' as a psychological tactic; potential unauthorized use of the Nubikk brand; external search results suggesting scam behavior and unresolved complaints; and lack of robust privacy/policy documentation. These collectively characterize Fake Online Shopping scams.
